title: Uncategorized's page is read-only with a link to the General Matrix
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings › Categories.
  2. Click Uncategorized's row.
  3. Click the Pricing Matrix box.
  4. Click the Tax Exempt checkbox.
  5. Point at the grayed Edit.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Uncategorized is the first row, on the General Matrix.

Step 2:

  • Uncategorized's page opens with the General Matrix's grid.
  • Its title cannot be clicked to rename it.
  • The page offers no Delete.
  • The Pricing Matrix box shows, grayed, reading General Matrix.
  • The Tax Exempt checkbox shows, grayed.
  • Edit is grayed, with a "Go to the General Matrix" link beside it.

Step 3:

  • No matrix list opens; the box still reads General Matrix, grayed.

Step 4:

  • The checkbox keeps the state it showed before the click, grayed.

Step 5:

  • A tooltip starts "Can't edit here. The General Matrix prices".
